$comment: Shared twin case table for openbindings.openapi@1 §9.2: what a form part whose resolved Schema Object declares no `type` defaults to, per accepted OAS edition. The admitted/refused half of every cell is derived from the pinned OAS bytes and is portable meaning; the emission string is a pinned rendering of each engine, normalized so that an omitted per-part Content-Type header and an explicit text/plain one read alike ([RFC7578] Section 4.4 permits both). Every harness executing this table renders the case as a WHOLE OpenAPI document and loads it through its own engine's shipped loader; a cell whose document does not load at all decides `source-refused`. A boolean-literal part schema is deliberately absent — see the generator's header. Generated by corpus-lab/scripts/build-part-default-type-absent-table.mjs; edit that script, not this file.
